findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service · Private data: search_services, get_service · Public sink: search_services, submit_rating.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service · Private data: search_services, get_service · Public sink: search_services, submit_rating

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
